decision: seal at exact merged commit SHA, then park; no runner-review head or execution is scheduled
declaration_seal_head_kind: merge commit of PR #398 (2026-09-12), the head at which the owner confirmed pre-seal complete; ancestor of main
why_not_0e869fea: PR #326 merge 0e869feae627e3da2c6fe03365c6482671aafe2b carries an earlier test file (blob b3c2fcb0); every other sealed file is byte-identical between the two heads. The seal binds the tests too, so the head that carries the reviewed tests is the only coherent identity.
sealed_files_identity_rule: raw byte identity against the tree named by declaration_seal_head; pretty-print, key reordering, or any re-normalization is not an admissible substitute

frozen_source_verification_at_seal.method: byte count and SHA-256 of each repo-relative path, the same identity check the pre-seal --check-only preflight performs

preseal_exposure_precount.item: whether a label-free, effect-free exposure pre-count (R5a short-gap rankable events under the §6.3 selector; P1/P2 GT-pair counts per q_v bin) may be taken before seal
preseal_exposure_precount.rationale: the sealed bytes are sealed as reviewed; any count over the frozen pair table reads formal rows and spends the blind boundary the seal protects (declaration §4.1). An exposure shortfall at execution time is an accepted OWDL_INVALID_STUDY risk, not a negative outcome, and repair requires a new declaration.

frozen_source_custody.item: the nine frozen sources are gitignored and untracked (out/, results/); whether to make a custody copy
frozen_source_custody.custody_layout: repo-relative paths preserved under the root; SHA256SUMS at the root; files and directories read-only
frozen_source_custody.custody_status: byte copy only; the copy is not a second identity. A future runner must still verify the study-spec hashes against whichever path it reads, and the repo-relative paths remain the declared identities.

authority_binding_slots.declaration_seal_head: carried here; stays null in the sealed study spec by construction (declaration §1.1)
authority_binding_slots.runner_review_head: not issued; no runner-review receipt exists

resume_conditions: an owner scheduling decision that names a runner-review phase and reacquires the semantic sole-active slot
sealed_files raw byte identity against declaration_seal_head still holds at the runner-review head (first gate; mismatch is terminal)
frozen_source_files 9/9 byte-identical at the paths the runner reads (repo paths or custody root)
post_seal_state.discard_condition: if the nine frozen sources cannot be reproduced byte-identically from the repo paths or the custody root, the thread's 'source identity cannot be frozen or reconstructed without a new runtime run' discard condition applies
